subject: fidelity and historical state
outcome: The exhibit displays the schematic tier, per-instance source-confidence labels and a visible explanation that extant or restored fabric and original sculpture are not represented.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Identify schematic, evidence-based and survey-validated portions accurately
Distinguish original, current, restored and conjectural conditions in the viewer
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: Not a georeferenced scan, surveyed restoration or complete archaeological digital twin.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
